messages:
jess: Customer on platinum plan reports JSON-mode streaming got cut mid-object when using our JS SDK behind Cloudflare Workers. They see final bytes: '..."value": "completed" }\n' missing closing array bracket. Repro attached.
kevin_eng: Can you paste the minimal repro curl or SDK snippet? Also want header traces (connection reuse, proxy hops).
maria_support: Pasting customer's curl they ran:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?mode=json
```
Response tail:
```
data: {"id":"rsp_123","object":"response","output":{"choices": [{"index":0,"value":"{\"foo\":\"bar\""}\n```
They get EOF right after missing closing braces.
kevin_eng: Hmm. Did they use our SDK with streaming parser? Cloudflare Workers sometimes buffer and close early on long-lived connections if no body bytes for ~1s.
infra-oncall: We had a transient keepalive regression in worker-proxy on 2026-03-04 where idle window dropped to 1s for some routes. Can you get request id + route? :eyes: 
jess: cust id: CUST-882, request id x-req-id: r-88b3a, region: eu-west-1. They said SDK keeps connection open; their worker logs show `upstream FIN, code 0`.
maria_support: Customer tried increasing heartbeat in SDK to every 200ms but still saw early FIN. They also tried direct curl from laptop (no CF) and it completes fine. So looks like CF worker -> our edge interaction.
kevin_eng: Repro steps good. Can product/infra triage: we should capture tcpdump/edge logs for r-88b3a and also check proxy keepalive settings for the specific upstream. If proxy closed mid-chunk, our stream parser on client sees truncated JSON. Patch idea: emit final newline and keep small keepalive bytes to prevent upstream idle window closures.
infra-oncall: I pulled the edge logs: route eu-west-1, upstream pod ip 10.3.12.7, we sent last chunk but worker socket reset after 860ms of silence. There's a proxy idle_timeout override on that node set to 1s due to misconfig from 2026-02-28 deploy. Rolling fix now. :hammer_and_wrench: 
kevin_eng: For customers: suggest SDK retry on parsefail with incremental buffer and request id header to resume, and add defensive truncation handling with last-good-object detection. I'll open a ticket to add 'streaming-json-recover' heuristics.
maria_support: Update customer: we believe this was a transient edge config that caused FIN on idle windows <1s, engineers rolling fix. Suggested workaround: use direct region endpoint or add short keepalives in worker until fix.
jess: Thanks. Customer wants ETA — ETA for fix?
infra-oncall: Rolling restart in progress; expect fix to reach edge in 12-18 minutes. Will follow up when deployed. :rocket: 
kevin_eng: Created ENG-4512 with repro, logs, and suggested workaround. Tagging @platform for follow-up. :+1: 
maria_support: Noted, ping me when done and I'll close with customer.
